text:
sam_cs: Heads-up on Seabreeze account. onboarding finished but retention signal weak; renewal Q4. Their /generate summaries route is largest cost driver and UX complains about occasional 2s+ tails. thinking a proactive performance play (quantize + small model hop + smarter routing) might secure renewal. thoughts?

jia_se: Agree we should act. My read: they value latency > perfect fidelity. Could swap to a smaller LLM for short prompts and int4 for long ones.

ron_ml: Ran a quick fidelity pass on 100 canonical prompts. redwood-int4-beta keeps key facts for ~92% of cases, semantic cosine median 0.985 vs baseline. Failure modes mostly long multi-paragraph context where hallucination slightly higher. Recommend canary + strict semantic gating.

lina_sre: infra note: tenant is on shared us-east cluster. We can route a percentage to a dedicated low-latency pool but that costs ~15% more; hybrid routing could keep cost down. Also can enable KV cache for summaries to shave tail latency.

sam_cs: OK prioritize latency. Proposal: 1) 3% traffic to redwood-int4-beta for /generate-short, 2) route long-context > 1024 tokens to redwood-fp16-stable, 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. If semantic match drops or 95p > 1600ms rollback.

jia_se: small clarification: using content-length heuristic for routing or embed-based classification?

ron_ml: Suggest embed-length heuristic + fallback test: if input tokens > 800 -> fp16; else int4. For classification edge cases, we can compute fast embedding and use cosine against a seed set to decide high-risk queries.

marta_pm: capture this as a customer playbook item in renewal package. Also include a 2-slide ROI summary: projected token cost -25% and median 95p latency down ~20% for their profile.

lina_sre: ops checklist: provisioning for canary nodes, KV cache toggle, alert: semantic_cosine < 0.975 for 20m and 95p_latency > 1600ms for 15m. I'll add a dashboard tile for cache hit rate and token-cost delta.

sam_cs: draft customer email: "We recommend a low-risk pilot to improve latency and lower costs: 48h A/B canary that shifts a sliver of traffic to an optimized int4 path with automated fallbacks. We'll monitor quality and can revert instantly. Want to schedule next Tue?"

jia_se: add one-line about safeguards: "automated semantic gate and immediate fallback to fp16 on mismatch".

# routing snippet (jia_se):

```
route: "seabreeze-generate"
policy:
  - condition: tokens(input) < 800 and rand() < 0.03
    target: redwood-int4-beta
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 800
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
  - condition: header.user_tier == "enterprise" and rand() < 0.10
    target: redwood-dedicated-lowlatency
fallback:
  - on_semantic_cosine_lt: 0.975
    action: route_to redwood-fp16-stable
  - on_latency_gt: 1600ms
    action: route_to redwood-dedicated-lowlatency
```

ron_ml: I'll prep a seed prompt set and automated comparator that outputs diff examples + cosine scores. sharing notebook before canary.

marta_pm: also add a 1-question quick survey after canary: "Did response speed meet expectations? (yes / close / no)" for qualitative signal tied to renewal.

lina_sre: ops-bot: create alert channel #cs-seabreeze-alerts for semantic_cosine < 0.975 (20m) and 95p_latency > 1600ms (15m). owner=lina_sre.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-seabreeze-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.975 (20m), 95p_latency > 1600ms (15m). owner: lina_sre.

sam_cs: timeline: canary start Mon 09:00 ET for 48h, mid-point sync Tue afternoon, decision Wed morning. I'll book a 30m enablement with their engs Tue 11:00 ET.

jia_se: checklist for enablement: - explain int4 tradeoffs and fallback - show routing snippet - how to read canary dashboards - rollback plan

ron_ml: quick note: we'll keep a mirrored evaluation on full prompt set to measure drift; auto-fail if semantic_cosine median drops > 0.012.

sam_cs: thanks all. i'll send the customer note and attach the ROI slides + one-question pulse. will post updates here. :rocket:
